governance.description: Standardized India-ready ML predictor schema enforcing strict tier isolation across National, Regional, and Deep Intelligence.

CORE_NATIONAL.description: Mandatory features available uniformly across India for national flood risk screening.

REGIONAL_EXPANSION.description: Hydrological and administrative features available at state/district/basin level.

DEEP_ZONE_EXCLUSIVE.description: High-resolution physical features exclusive to validated Deep Intelligence Zones (e.g. Mumbai/Mithi). Must NOT be required for National models.
